correctness.rationale: Headline is a negative TARGET resolution: C(3)=1 != 0=[q^3]P kills the product for any prefactor q^a, and C(4)=1 kills c(5n+4)=0 at n=0. Hand proof verified independently: [3] is the unique partition of 3 with parts>=2 and satisfies the gap condition vacuously, so C(3)=1; to O(q^3) P(q)=1/(1-q^2)+O(q^7) since numerator is 1 mod q^18 and only allowed part <=3 is 2, so [q^3]P=0. Both series have constant term 1 (empty partition; empty product), so any a>=1 fails at n=0; a=0 fails at n=3. Hence all a>=0 fail, a fortiori a=0..10. C(4)=1 checked: candidates [4] admissible, [2,2] gap 0<2 excluded. Independent brute-force re-enumeration (own generator, n<=10) reproduces C=[1,0,1,1,1,1,2,2,3,3,3] matching verify_results.json. Machine expansion to O(q^80) is corroborating evidence, not the proof: verify.py computes C by DP cross-checked by brute force to n=30 (A1==A2) and P by two opposite-order series constructions (B1==B2), finding 77 mismatches in 0..80, first at 3, no shift a=0..10 matching. DP skip 'rem-curr==1' is sound (remainder 1 unpartitionable with parts>=2). Dissection first-nonzero entries verified against C table: r=0:(0,0,1), r=1:(1,6,2) since C1=0,C6=2, r=2:(0,2,1), r=3:(0,3,1), r=4:(0,4,1). TARGET alternative branch ('exact failing residue class and first witness as logged') is satisfied with r=4, witness C(4)=1. Proof vs evidence distinguished: falsification is hand-proved at n<=4; O(q^80) log is experimental benchmark.

originality.rationale: TARGET route: audited normally. One consolidated scope_literature_search with three normalized forms was issued: (a) literal exact-product plus c(5n+4) statement, (b) equivalent/dual gap-condition plus residues 2,7,12 mod 18 Bailey-pair formulation, (c) dominance/census query for expanded Slater list / mod-18 classification / RRSDB covering result. All providers succeeded (serpbase/serpent/openalex/crossref ok, 20 fused hits, partial=false), so no fail-closed priority. No exact, synonymous (q-shift/complement/dual/incidence), or stronger-covering source was returned: literal query returned only generic partition-congruence pages; equivalent query returned the MSZ survey, bilateral-Bailey and mod-18/24 family papers as neighboring categories, not this triple product; census query returned the survey second edition, RRSDB landing page, Schlosser bilaterals. Fetched RRSDB homepage (project in progress, no identity table covering this product) and survey landing metadata. Since the conjectured identity was admitted as absent from those tables, its elementary falsity at n=3 cannot be a recomputation/corollary of a known stronger fact; no prior source states or implies C(3) vs P(3) for this pair. See decisive_checks for adversarial checklist.

value.rationale: TARGET negative resolution with logged obstruction, explicitly admitted as valuable partial ('product plus c(5n+4)=0 family, or certified residue log showing which progression fails'). Object and invariant were motivated before computation: Slater-list dual gap flagged by McLaughlin-Sills-Zimmer survey, natural level 18 of the dual pair, prime 5 smallest dissection prime not dividing level, downstream modular-benchmark / Bailey-chain classification use stated in topic. Result is a rigorously established exact datum (first mismatch n=3 with C=1/P=0; failing progression r=4 with witness C(4)=1; full mod-5 dissection to O(q^80) showing every class inhabited from its first term) that was not known or mechanically implied and that a future researcher needs to avoid re-proposing the same dual product and to benchmark any corrected residue set. Per value policy a narrow exact invariant of a motivated natural object is not rejected merely for being one datum, and an honestly-described incomplete census does not erase the headline. Certification alone is not rescuing an arbitrary object here: scope is natural, not a parameter substitution, with stated downstream use. Limitations honestly scoped (no corrected-residue classification, Bailey lift moot). Independently worth retrieving.
